##### Project General Facts

The Farmhouses embody the quintessence of a serene and idyllic lifestyle, carefully crafted to provide a tranquil escape from the chaos of city life, with majestic European and North American style farmhouses that evoke the charm of a bygone era. These resplendent residences boast expansive living areas, perfectly complemented by capacious outdoor spaces, including fully-equipped horse stables, a farm animal barnyard, an exotic flower garden, and a relaxation retreat, all carefully designed to cater to the diverse passions and interests of their discerning owners. The Farmhouses' sophisticated design aesthetic is brought to life by premium finishing and high-quality materials, which are meticulously integrated into the architecture to create a truly unparalleled living experience.

The Farmhouses offer an array of indulgent amenities, including sunken fire pits, glamping tent areas, and state-of-the-art hydroponic farms, all of which converge to create a holistic living experience that nourishes both body and soul. The possibilities for leisure and entertainment are endless, with options ranging from hosting convivial barbecue parties to engaging in meditative yoga retreats, all set against the picturesque backdrop of lush green landscapes and soothing natural beauty. As the sun sets, the outdoor VIP cinema beckons, promising an enchanting evening of entertainment under the starry skies.

The interior of The Farmhouses is a masterclass in elegant design, with premium finishing and high-quality materials that exude refinement and poise, complemented by equipped kitchens that cater to the epicurean pursuits of their owners. The overall effect is one of understated luxury, where every detail, from the beautiful layouts to the state-of-the-art appliances, has been carefully considered to create a living environment that is at once opulent and homely.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills 2 is a haven of tranquility, where the gentle rustle of leaves and the sweet songs of birds replace the cacophony of city life, providing a serene atmosphere that is perfect for relaxation and recreation. The community is strategically located, with easy access to four major highways, making it an ideal destination for those seeking a peaceful retreat without sacrificing connectivity to the city. As one approaches Damac Hills 2, the lush greenery and wholesome experiences come into view, creating a sense of anticipation and excitement for the adventures that await.

The community at Damac Hills 2 is a vibrant tapestry of experiences, where luxury living, brilliant spaces, and a sense of belonging converge to create a unique and captivating lifestyle. Water Town, with its wave-riding paradise and array of water attractions, promises endless hours of fun and excitement, while Sports Town offers a plethora of opportunities for outdoor enthusiasts to indulge in their favorite pursuits. From the outdoor gym to the tennis and padel tennis courts, every facility is meticulously crafted to provide an exhilarating experience.

Damac Hills 2 is a world of wonder, where the great outdoors is celebrated in all its glory, and every moment is an opportunity to create unforgettable memories. Down Town, with its Zen Garden, picnic park, and dance studio, is a space dedicated to good energy and great times, where families can come together to enjoy quality time and make the most of the beautiful surroundings. The outdoor cinema, petting farm, and bird enclosure add to the magic, creating a truly enchanting atmosphere that is sure to captivate visitors of all ages.
